gloss: right next to one's ear; close to the ear

definitions.gloss: right next to one's ear; close to the ear
definitions.explanation: The area immediately beside someone's ear. Typically used in expressions about whispering, shouting close by, or sounds heard from very near.

examples.japanese: {耳元|みみもと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ささやいた。
examples.english: She whispered right next to my ear.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{耳元|みみもと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧「⟦{頑張|がんば}って→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: My mother said "do your best" close to my ear.

examples.japanese: ⟦{蚊|か}→蚊：04294_ka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{耳元|みみもと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ブンブン⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{飛|と}び{回|まわ}って→飛び回る：04610_tobimawaru⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れなかった→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧。
examples.english: A mosquito was buzzing right next to my ear, so I couldn't sleep.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧ (ear) + ⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧ (vicinity, base). The ⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧ element indicates the spot immediately adjacent to something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {耳元|みみもと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ささやく: to whisper in someone's ear
- {耳元|みみもと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{叫|さけ}ぶ→叫ぶ：02108_sakebu⟧: to shout right next to someone's ear
- {耳元|みみもと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{囁|ささや}く→囁く：03933_sasayaku⟧: to murmur close to the ear
- {耳元|みみもと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{寄|よ}せる→寄せる：02329_yoseru⟧: to bring one's mouth close to the ear

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧そば: by the ear — more neutral, less idiomatic
- {耳|みみ}たぶ: earlobe — the body part, not the space around it
